inspiration.source_location: ALTER TABLE syntax BNF: alter_specification FORCE
inspiration.observed_pattern: MariaDB accepts FORCE as an ALTER TABLE alteration specification that rebuilds an existing table without changing its logical rows.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced from the independently authored registry maintenance case to one InnoDB row, one ALTER TABLE FORCE statement, and one ordered read, isolating the parser mismatch from online DDL option handling and post-alter writes.

fixture_notes: The single registry row must survive ALTER TABLE FORCE unchanged.
determinism_notes: The row identity and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE rebuild_probe (probe_id INT PRIMARY KEY, probe_label VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, probe_score INT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB

checks.sql: SELECT probe_id, probe_label, probe_score FROM rebuild_probe ORDER BY probe_id
